subject: Coverage and SLAs for upcoming third-party security audit
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Coverage and SLAs for upcoming third-party security audit

Team —

We need to lock the vendor and SOW for our annual third-party security assessment. Key asks up front so we can compare proposals: 

- Scope: external perimeter pen test + targeted web app red team (authenticated + CI pipeline review optional).
- Deliverables: executive summary, full technical report with reproducible PoCs, evidence bundle for audit, and remediation tracking spreadsheet.
- Timeline: testing window in September (preferred Sept 13–24), final report within 10 business days after close.
- SLAs: incident-response contact, 24/7 on-call for investigations during test window, and a clear escalation matrix.
- Commercial constraints: vendor must accept our standard PO/Net30 terms or propose alternative; provide itemized pricing: retainer, day rates, optional remediation verification.

Please see the attached risk register for context and any constraints from legal. Olena (infosec) is out next week, so please surface any critical security constraints now.

Attachments: [Attachment: Risk_Register_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Can you each take a lane: Karthik — procurement/PO terms; Marissa — vendor scoring matrix + SOW language; Laura — contracting/insurance checklist. I’ll coordinate technical Q&A with vendors.

Olga
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Coverage and SLAs for upcoming third-party security audit

Got it — I can take PO/terms. A few quick notes: 

- Net30 is standard but we can push for Net45 if vendor requests; for smaller consultancies they prefer Net15.
- We need vendor proof of cyber liability insurance (see Laura for limits).
- If vendor requires a retainer for scheduling a red team, confirm whether it's refundable or applies to final invoice.

I’ll draft a one-page procurement checklist and circulate by EOD Monday.

Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
From: Amy Chen <amy@aegissec.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@aegissec.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 14:40:00 +0000
Subject: AegisSec proposal — red team + appsec (Sept window)

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the opportunity to respond. Attached is our proposal tailored to the scope you outlined (external pen test + targeted red team against webapp auth flows). Highlights: 

- Team: 2 senior red teamers + 1 engagement lead for 10 days on-site/remote mix.
- Timeline: available Sept 13–24; draft report delivered within 7 business days, final report after validation within 10 business days.
- Evidence: reproducible PoCs, raw logs, and a drive-staged evidence bundle.
- SLAs: 4-hour initial response for critical findings during testing window; dedicated Slack channel for the engagement; escalation to EMEA/North America leadership if not acknowledged within 6 hours.
- Pricing: line items for baseline assessment, add-on CI/CD pipeline review, and optional remediation verification.

Attachments: [Attachment: Aegis_RedTeam_Proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: Aegis_SLAs.xlsx (xlsx)]

We can accept Redwood’s PO, but we typically ask for Net30 on final invoice and a 25% scheduling retainer to secure the Sept window. The retainer is applied to the final invoice. Happy to walk through the proposal on a call — available Wed/Thu afternoon.

Best,
Amy Chen
Engagement Lead, AegisSec
amy@aegissec.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@aegissec.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AegisSec proposal — red team + appsec (Sept window)

Thanks Amy — quick follow-ups so we can score the proposal against other vendors: 

1) Can you break the pricing into: baseline assessment, red team day rate, travel (if any), remediation verification, and CI/CD review as separate line items?
2) Please confirm the maximum number of concurrent testers during the window and whether any junior testers will be used for PoC development.
3) SLA clarification: your sheet mentions 4-hour initial response for critical findings — can you provide an SLA-backed credit or remedy if missed?
4) Do you sign our standard NDA/SSPA or do you require their version?

I attached a short set of auditor/vendor questions so the team can track responses. Please add answers in the spreadsheet and return by Friday so we can finalize scoring.

Attachments: [Attachment: Audit_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)]

Marissa
Lead, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Chen <amy@aegissec.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@aegissec.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AegisSec proposal — red team + appsec (Sept window)

Marissa —

Thanks for the questions — answers below and I’ve attached an updated pricing appendix.

1) Pricing: baseline assessment $28,000; red team day rate $4,000/day (10 days nominal); remediation verification $3,500; CI/CD review $6,000. Travel estimated separately if on-site required. See attached appendix.
2) Testers: two senior testers will own the engagement end-to-end. We do not use junior testers for PoC dev without explicit approval — seniors produce final PoCs.
3) SLA remedies: we can add a service credit equal to 5% of the engagement fee for any missed critical-response SLA (acknowledgment > 6 hours). We’ll include this in the SOW addendum.
4) NDA/SSPA: we can sign Redwood’s SSPA; we just ask to confirm required insurance limits (we carry $5M cyber liability).

Document links: proposal appendix on Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cAegisProposal
DocuSign (scheduling retainer/statement of work): https://app.docusign.com/DocuSign/claim/ABCDEFG123456

We can accept the Net30 PO; retainer is 25% applied to final invoice. If that works, we’ll send the SOW + DocuSign to the contact on file.

Best,
Amy Chen
Engagement Lead, AegisSec
Attachments: [Attachment: Aegis_Pricing_Appendix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
